info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Creditcard Applications Decline-v2-spec
info.description: The Decline Credit Card Applications API allows authorized users to permanently withdraw credit card applications that have been flagged for decline. This operation is essential for maintaining accurate records and ensuring that non-viable applications do not remain in the system. Financial institutions and credit providers typically utilize this API to manage their application workflows effectively. The endpoint ensures compliance with internal policies and assists in providing clarity to applicants regarding their application status.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to decline a submitted application, effectively removing it from consideration. Ensure that you have the necessary permissions to perform this action as it may impact the applicant's status.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details of the application that is to be declined. Please ensure that the provided information adheres to the expected schema to avoid errors during processing.
